Explore multiple machines, investigate applications, uncover security flaws, and demonstrate your bug bounty and penetration testing skills. Each machine may contain multiple vulnerabilities, challenging you to think beyond the obvious and investigate how different weaknesses can be discovered and exploited. Event Details Event Date: 14 November 2026, 12:00 PM – 15 November 2026, 12:00 PM IST Duration: 24 hours Registration Fee: Free Mode: Online Who Can Participate: Open to everyone of all skill levels Lab Access: Competition machines provided by the organizers What to Expect Hands-on Security Testing: Explore dedicated lab machines and identify vulnerabilities across web applications, APIs, and other in-scope services. Multiple Vulnerabilities: Go beyond finding a single flaw and investigate each machine thoroughly. Practical Learning: Access full walkthroughs to understand the intended solutions, exploitation techniques, and underlying security concepts. Overview

Step into the Multiverse Wars, a free, hands-on cybersecurity competition hosted by Hackosquad, where security enthusiasts can test their skills against real-world-style vulnerabilities in controlled lab environments.

Explore multiple machines, investigate applications, uncover security flaws, and demonstrate your bug bounty and penetration testing skills. Each machine may contain multiple vulnerabilities, challenging you to think beyond the obvious and investigate how different weaknesses can be discovered and exploited.

Event Details

  • Event Date: 14 November 2026, 12:00 PM – 15 November 2026, 12:00 PM IST
  • Duration: 24 hours
  • Registration Fee: Free
  • Mode: Online
  • Who Can Participate: Open to everyone of all skill levels
  • Lab Access: Competition machines provided by the organizers

What to Expect

  • Hands-on Security Testing: Explore dedicated lab machines and identify vulnerabilities across web applications, APIs, and other in-scope services.
  • Multiple Vulnerabilities: Go beyond finding a single flaw and investigate each machine thoroughly.
  • Practical Learning: Access full walkthroughs to understand the intended solutions, exploitation techniques, and underlying security concepts.
  • Recognition and Rewards: Participants who meet the event requirements may receive a certificate. Vouchers and additional rewards may be offered for outstanding submissions.

How to Participate

  • Register for the event, access the competition environment, and begin investigating the provided machines during the event window. Submit clear, well-documented vulnerability reports according to the published scope and competition rules.
  • All testing must remain within the organizer-provided environment and authorized scope.

One multiverse. Multiple machines. Countless ways to find a flaw.

Ready to enter the Multiverse Wars? Register now and put your security skills to the test!
